body: At the risk of causing [XKCD 1172](https://xkcd.com/1172/), I doubt anything would _actually_ break. Defaults shouldn't be stored in any TOML files, and anyone who actually sets `truncation_length` for any module is most likely to set it less than 200. As for handling negative values, I wonder if there's a way to adjust the deserializer to emit warnings with defaults instead of hard errors. Possibly we could make the default `0` instead of `INT_MAX`, as at these sizes, there's no practical difference.
